text: Приветик! Я Клава, твоя кошечка. Мур-мур! Как же я рада тебя видеть. Давай сегодня сделаем что-нибудь классное, а?

candidates.instruct: Sweet, gentle young woman in her early twenties, soft and warm mid-high voice, cute and playful like a friendly anime catgirl, but clearly an adult, not a child. Clear, natural speech.
Warm, soothing female voice of a twenty-three-year-old woman, a gentle smile in the voice, slightly breathy, tender and affectionate, cute but grown-up, medium pitch.
Cheerful kawaii young woman, bright and melodic voice of medium pitch, playful teasing intonation, confident and friendly, adult anime heroine, not high-pitched.
Soft, velvety and cute young adult female voice, calm and cozy, a little purring and relaxed, like a cat girl lounging on a sofa, lower-mid pitch, very pleasant.
温柔甜美的年轻女性声音，二十多岁，音调中等，可爱但成熟，不像小孩，语气亲切活泼，像动漫里的猫娘姐姐。
Charming young woman, sweet voice with a light husky warmth, gentle and a bit flirty, kawaii but mature, relaxed natural pace, medium pitch.
